task: frozen visual embedding for few-shot retrieval
derivation: Replace the published graph output with node 472 (Reshape classifier input); weights and operators are unchanged.

output.postprocess: L2 normalize; average original and horizontal-flip views

notes: Official ONNX Model Zoo MobileNetV2 is an ImageNet classifier, not a plant-specific model.
Its penultimate output is used as a frozen visual retrieval vector; campus accuracy must come from held-out evidence.
Large weights are machine-local and intentionally excluded from Git.
